page_title: ATA 0-0 LAZ | Atalanta v Lazio 19/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+4' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+3' Giuseppe Collu has a clear sight and sees a foul from Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta).
90+2' The corner from Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) is cleared away by the defence.
90' We will have 3 min. of added time.
90' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Lazio.
89' Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. Now Lazio have a corner.
86' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Oliver Provstgaard (Lazio) will replace Nuno Tavares.
86' Maurizio Sarri has decided to substitute Adam Marusic and he is replaced by Manuel Lazzari (Lazio).
84' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) unleashes a shot, but his effort is poor and flies well wide of the left post.
82' Substitution. Ademola Lookman makes way for Daniel Maldini (Atalanta).
81' Chance! Marten de Roon (Atalanta) gets to the rebound on the edge of the box and smashes the ball towards the bottom right corner, but Ivan Provedel is alert and makes a great save to deny him.
81' What an opportunity! Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) disappointed the fans as he smashed a first-time shot from inside the box against the left post!
80' Atalanta can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

80' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence. Atalanta force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
79' Matias Vecino (Lazio) pulls the trigger and strikes the ball towards goal from long-range, but his effort is blocked by one of the defenders.
78' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
75' Maurizio Sarri decides to make a substitution. Toma Basic will be replaced by Matias Vecino (Lazio).
75' It's time for a substitution. Pedro (Lazio) comes on in place of Mattia Zaccagni.
75' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
73' Lorenzo Bernasconi (Atalanta) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
72' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) rises high to connect with a cross from the corner kick, but his powerful header from near the penalty spot crashes against the crossbar!
72' Corner kick. Atalanta will have an opportunity.

71' Ivan Provedel was forced into action to thwart Ademola Lookman (Atalanta). He found himself some space after latching on to a pass and unleashed a shot to the bottom right corner but couldn't beat the keeper. The ball goes out for a corner. Atalanta can continue in their attacking effort.
71' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
70' Atalanta are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
68' Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box directed towards the right post, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
67' Here is a change. Honest Ahanor is going off and Ivan Juric gives the last tactical orders to Giorgio Scalvini (Atalanta).
67' It is time for a substitution. Marten de Roon is on for Mario Pasalic (Atalanta).
67' Ivan Juric has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Nikola Krstovic (Atalanta) replacing Kamaldeen Sulemana.
66' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
66' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Atalanta comes to nothing.
65' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
64' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) takes a mid-range free kick, but his miskick only goes into the stands. Poor shot!
62' Giuseppe Collu shows a yellow card to Isak Hien (Atalanta) for his blatant foul.
61' Honest Ahanor (Atalanta) meets a fine cross on the edge of the box from the resulting corner kick and shoots. His shot flies just wide of the left post.
61' Atalanta have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

60' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) connects with a precise cross inside the goalmouth and shoots. One of the defending players reacts in time and clears the ball to safety. Atalanta force a corner. They send men into the box.
60' The game is interrupted. Danilo Cataldi (Lazio) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
59' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ivan Provedel intercepts the ball.

57' Ederson (Atalanta) meets a pass on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the middle of the goal. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Ivan Provedel pulls off an easy save.
54' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
53' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Mario Pasalic (Atalanta) was quite harsh and Giuseppe Collu didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
52' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
50' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) rises high to meet a perfect cross, but luckily for the goalkeeper he steers his header just over the crossbar.
48' Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
47' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Giuseppe Collu has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
46' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Atalanta control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

43' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) latches on to a precise defence-splitting pass and drills a nice strike from a promising distance towards the middle of the goal. Ivan Provedel has a clear sight of it and makes a comfortable save.
40' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
39' Matteo Guendouzi (Lazio) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.
35' Giuseppe Collu blows his whistle. Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) commits a foul after dangerous play.
35' Gustav Isaksen (Lazio) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
33' A pass by Ademola Lookman (Atalanta) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
31' Toma Basic (Lazio) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, sending it towards the right post only for Marco Carnesecchi to dive and make a save.
30' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Giuseppe Collu had an easy-decision to make.
28' Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
25' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Lazio, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
24' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) commits a rough foul. Giuseppe Collu stops the game and makes a call.
22' Maurizio Sarri is forced to make a change. Matteo Cancellieri is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Gustav Isaksen (Lazio).
21' Ederson (Atalanta) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lazio.
17' The possession of the ball – 53:47.
15' The corner is swung in but Atalanta can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
14' Kamaldeen Sulemana (Atalanta) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. Atalanta will take a corner kick.
12' The resulting set piece from Atalanta is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
11' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Davide Zappacosta (Atalanta). Good work from Atalanta as they win a corner.
9' Charles De Ketelaere (Atalanta) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
6' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Atalanta.

4' Nuno Tavares (Lazio) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Giuseppe Collu with no other option than to blow for a foul.
1' The first half has just begun.
Lazio will kick the game off.
Giuseppe Collu is the one to supervise the game today.
